intro.text: The Forest is too dangerous, Milo! A mystical barrier blocks the gate. Do you have the proper gear?

choices.text: Yes, I am ready to enter!
Not yet. Where can I find it?

give_quest_tips.text: Listen well! Search the Old Ruins for the Shield, Volcano Caves for the Cloak, and the Sun Temple for the Sword. Take this potion for your safety!

choices.text: Thank you, Tallen! I will return soon.

check_gear_choice.text: I am traveling to find my sister... I must pass, even if I have to force my way through!

guardian_warning.text: Determination won't crack the lock, boy. Bring the Sword, Shield, and Cloak first!
